# Marcato

> > Italian pasta machine manufacturer since 1930, specializing in handcrafted machines and accessories for homemade fresh pasta and baking.

Marcato is renowned for its iconic Atlas pasta machine and comprehensive range of pasta-making equipment including the Pasta Fresca, Ampia, and specialized accessories. The company combines traditional Italian craftsmanship with modern design to help home cooks create authentic fresh pasta, from spaghetti and tagliatelle to regional specialties like bigoli and corzetti.

## Key Topics

- Atlas pasta machine
- Pasta Fresca
- Italian pasta making
- Fresh pasta accessories
- Bigoli and Capellini cutters
- Pastadrive motor
- Clever cutter and Il Tarocco tools
- Multipast and Pastaset kits
- Homemade pasta equipment
- Kitchen utensils and dough scrapers
- Biscuits press
- Pasta machine accessories
- Made in Italy craftsmanship
- Traditional Italian pasta shapes

- [Biscuits Design | Macchine per la pasta | Shop on line Biscuits Design](https://www.marcato.it/de/products/biscuits-design): Biscuits Design press - 20 shapes in 2 sizes, 7 color options
